summary: Router-standard Wallet Web evidence is not complete from installed/public runtime; local/source validation is out-of-scope by request.

blocker.instruction: Run one bounded real-browser blocker proving public installed/runtime evidence for all remaining gates before source/public release promotion.
steps: Open the exact public current-source URL from release/integration contract in one fresh Chrome profile and verify page URL remains stable while connecting (no extra top-level tab).
Connect with YNX Wallet and MetaMask simultaneously present; verify chooser shows both brands with correct logos and requires explicit selection.
Run approve and reject wallet flows on installed provider and capture a single-session proof where rejection does not expose an approved account.
Execute chain lifecycle with proof of 0x1917 add/switch/read in same session.
Trigger refresh, then verify account/address and chain restored without modal or blank-tab navigation.
Emit wallet events: accountsChanged, chainChanged, disconnect, and capture revoke flow that clears session state.

Execute signed actions in first-party plus 3 separate external dApps using connected session and prove each action requires explicit user confirmation (personal_sign, eth_signTypedData / EIP712, eth_sendTransaction).
Capture stable URL + no blank top-level tabs for callback separation and wallet action path; include final console screenshot bundle as evidence.
Create one signed evidence envelope and reference it from product-release or contract when all checks pass.
notes: Do not use source build, CI logs, or local-only flows as replacement proof for installed/public lifecycle.
No separate prompt or extension for collecting private key material is allowed for any signing action.
